title: Good food in Ubi, Hougang, Woodleigh, Paya Lebar and Eunos
summary: The 100 places food writers recommend most within 1 km of Ubi, Hougang, Kovan, Woodleigh, Paya Lebar and Eunos MRT stations, ranked by how many independent guides name them. Filter by area or cuisine, see the places on an overview map and on one map per area, read a sourced calorie estimate (carbohydrate, protein, fat) for 82 of the 100 signature dishes, and see how each place was checked against a mall directory or a recent guide as of 4 October 2026.
